edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the balance that is decremented in transfer.
msg.sender forms the spender key of allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Caller address is passed as the mint recipient in the ICO fallback external call.
msg.sender is the owner key written in approve.
msg.sender is the owner key updated in increaseApproval.
msg.sender is the owner key updated in decreaseApproval.
onlyOwner compares the caller address against the stored owner.
burner local is assigned directly from msg.sender.
Crowdsale admission depends on the miner-influenceable block timestamp.
totalSupply is read and incremented during mint.
totalSupply is read and decremented during burn.
balances mapping provides the value decremented in transfer.
balances[_from] is decremented in transferFrom.
balances[burner] is decremented in burn.
allowed mapping is decremented in transferFrom.
allowed mapping is written in approve.
allowed mapping is incremented in increaseApproval.
allowed mapping is decremented in decreaseApproval.
Stored owner is the reference value in the onlyOwner authorization check.
Owner state variable is overwritten by transferOwnership.
mintingFinished gates the canMint modifier on mint.
mintingFinished state influences supply-changing burn semantics.
Token contract reference is the target of the external mint call made before state finalization.
funds_address is the recipient of the ether transfer executed inside the fallback.
collected is added to the incoming value for the hard cap comparison and later update.
hard_cap bounds the SafeMath addition of the contribution.
rate converts msg.value into the minted token amount.
date_start bounds the timestamp admission check.
date_end bounds the timestamp admission check.
_value drives the SafeMath subtraction from the caller balance.
_from selects which balance entry is debited in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the allowance in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is stored verbatim as the allowance in approve.
_spender selects the allowance entry updated in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is summed into the allowance in increaseApproval.
_spender selects the allowance entry updated in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue drives the subtraction from oldValue.
newOwner is written into the privileged owner slot.
_to selects the balance credited during mint.
_amount is added to totalSupply during mint.
_amount is added to the recipient balance during mint.
_value is subtracted from the burner balance.
_value is subtracted from totalSupply.
oldValue is the minuend of the SafeMath subtraction in decreaseApproval.
Multiplication result is stored into local c inside SafeMath.mul.
Division result is stored into local c inside SafeMath.div.
Addition result is stored into local c inside SafeMath.add.
SafeMath.mul body performs the unchecked-at-language-level multiplication.
SafeMath.div body performs the division operation.
SafeMath.sub body performs the subtraction operation.
SafeMath.add body performs the addition operation.
transfer executes the balance subtraction and addition sequence.
transferFrom executes the source balance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction.
approve writes the allowance without a zero-first reset.
increaseApproval mutates the allowance with SafeMath add.
decreaseApproval mutates the allowance with SafeMath sub.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership performs the privileged owner reassignment.
mint increases the total supply.
mint credits the recipient balance.
burn debits the caller balance.
burn decreases the total supply.
The contribution require statement enforces the timestamp window inside the fallback.
The fallback evaluates the hard cap check and updates the collected counter.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the balance decrement.
transfer calls SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for the balances and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub.
mint calls SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
burn calls SafeMath.sub for balance and supply updates.
The fallback calls SafeMath.mul to convert msg.value by rate.
The fallback calls SafeMath.add to accumulate collected ether.
daysRemaining calls SafeMath.sub on the end date.
daysRemaining calls SafeMath.div by 1 days.
collectedEther calls SafeMath.div by 1 ether.
The fallback performs the external token.mint call before updating collected.
The fallback forwards ether to funds_address before finalizing state.
The external mint call re-enters the token contract mint logic holding pending ICO state.
The Ownable constructor assigns initial ownership to the deployer.
